Protest and Detentions Spark Debate on State Power and Assembly Rights

Thousands of activists, students, political leaders, and protesters faced detentions and travel restrictions following a protest on October 10. The events have reignited debate regarding the constitutional right to peaceful assembly and the extent of state power. The nature of the protest and its implications for the opposition have also been highlighted.
